name: Comcast Corporation
description: Comcast is currently organized around Connectivity & Platforms (Xfinity residential broadband, video and wireless via the Xfinity Mobile MVNO riding Verizon's network, plus Comcast Business services to enterprises) and Content & Experiences (NBCUniversal's broadcast/cable networks, Universal Pictures film studio, Peacock streaming service, Universal theme parks, and Sky, its European pay-TV/broadband operator). Comcast completed the spin-off of Versant Media Group (a subset of its cable television networks) in January 2026, and on 2026-06-29 announced its intention to separate NBCUniversal and Sky together into a standalone, independently-traded company via a tax-free transaction targeted to close in approximately 12 months, which — if completed as announced — would leave a much more narrowly-defined broadband/connectivity company at Comcast (CMCSA) itself.

gics.note: Conventional GICS box only; see mowgliClassification for how Mowgli actually places this company.

businessLines.name: Connectivity & Platforms
businessLines.description: Xfinity residential broadband, video and wireless (Xfinity Mobile), Comcast Business connectivity services to enterprises, and the Xumo/Now platforms; the segment most comparable to the US national telecom/broadband carriers.

revenue.note: Revenue fell ~3% YoY; segment profit (EBITDA) fell ~5.8% to $7.96 billion

businessLines.name: Media (NBCUniversal broadcast/cable networks, Peacock)
businessLines.description: NBC broadcast network, remaining cable news/entertainment networks (post-Versant spin-off), and Peacock streaming service.
businessLines.revenueNote: Total Media segment revenue not independently confirmed; Peacock alone contributed $1.9 billion of segment revenue in the quarter (including FIFA World Cup-related amounts) and reached first-ever quarterly profitability with $189 million of EBITDA; Peacock had 48 million paid subscribers as of 2026-06-30
businessLines.source: web search of Comcast Q2 2026 earnings coverage, 2026-09-28

businessLines.name: Studios, Theme Parks (Universal)
businessLines.description: Universal Pictures film/TV production and Universal Destinations & Experiences theme parks (Orlando, Hollywood, Japan, Beijing, and Epic Universe).
